description: Transfer a completed device-side file or file set to the NodeEngine host and verify every declared member.
summary: Transfer completed device files to the NodeEngine host and verify them.

deviceId.description: Device host from which the completed file is retrieved.

deviceArtifact.description: Device-produced file artifact containing one localPath or an ordered files list with per-file size/digest metadata. Each transferred entry requires localPath; fileName defaults to its basename, and sizeBytes/sha256 are optional verification metadata. All entries are checked before the first pull.

nodeDestinationDirectory.description: Optional NodeEngine-host destination directory; defaults to this protocol run directory.

device.fileTransfer.artifact.nodeFile.description: Verified NodeEngine-host file or file-set artifact together with its source device artifact provenance.
